text: Could you add a subtle watermark to this clip for me? I tend to overthink little finishing touches like this. What I want it to say is @flightschool, and it should sit at the bottom right for the whole clip. Please use small white text that is slightly see-through, with a faint shadow so it stays readable. Keep it away from the edges and leave everything else alone. I’m just a bit nervous about how the watermark will look.
